description: This file defines interfaces related to warning reporting, including warning events, reporting units, and control mechanisms within the Thunder namespace. It declares abstract classes and methods for handling warning events, configuring warning categories, and managing warning reporting controls.

classes.name: IWarningEvent
classes.description: Interface for warning event objects, providing methods for serialization, deserialization, categorization, and warning identification.

classes.name: IWarningReportingUnit
classes.description: Interface for warning reporting units, allowing reporting of warning events and management of warning categories.

classes.name: IWarningReportingControl
classes.description: Interface for control objects that manage warning categories, allowing exclusion, configuration, and cloning of warning category controls.

methods.name: Exclude
methods.description: Excludes a specified category from reporting.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures a warning category with specific settings.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the warning reporting control object.

methods.name: ReportWarningEvent
methods.description: Reports a warning event with a specific identifier.

methods.name: FetchCategoryInformation
methods.description: Retrieves information about a warning category, including whether it is default, enabled, and its configuration.

methods.name: AddToCategoryList
methods.description: Adds a warning reporting control to the category list.

methods.name: RemoveFromCategoryList
methods.description: Removes a warning reporting control from the category list.
